Container.Name: DaVinci Project Manager
Container.Overview: Manage user access to DaVinci Resolve network project libraries from a web browser.
Container.Description: Assign library access, create user logins, reset passwords, and lock accounts. Connects to an existing PostgreSQL server with the DaVinci Project Manager access module installed. The interface is available in English and Polish.
Container.Requires: Existing PostgreSQL instance with the access module installed and at least one registered Resolve project library.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port on your Unraid server.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL host
Config.Description: IP address or hostname reachable from this container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL port
Config.Description: TCP port of the existing PostgreSQL server.

Config.Name: Account registry database
Config.Description: Database containing the access module. The standard setup uses postgres.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL service account
Config.Description: Database login created by the access module installer.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL service password
Config.Description: The PANEL_DB_PASSWORD value from the access module setup.

Config.Name: Panel administrator password
Config.Description: A separate password of at least 32 characters. Enter it with a blank username on the sign-in page.

Config.Name: Session signing key
Config.Description: A random secret of at least 32 characters. Keep it across updates.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL TLS mode
Config.Description: Use prefer on a trusted LAN or choose a TLS mode supported by your server.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only session cookie
Config.Description: Set to 1 when a reverse proxy serves the panel over HTTPS.
